Pathfinder is a new objective system that asks Guardians to complete objectives in Crucible, Gambit, or Vanguard activities to earn a valuable reward. Open the Director and navigate to the Vanguard screen to learn more.

The goal of Pathfinder is to form a path of connected objectives from left to right and claim the engram reward. Any Pathfinder objective can be progressed at any time, but may only be claimed when connected by a path.

The whispers grow stronger. Their grief quelled, their vengeance almost sated. All that remains is to end the source of this corruption.
A dying wish has imprisoned you within a ruined cell. Use your wits, and find a method of escape.
You've arrived at the end of a trail of Dark Ether. Press forward, climb the ridgeline path, and discover what remains hidden in stormy peaks.
A corrupted Knight stands between you and answers. Meet their challenge, leave them broken, but beware latent curses.
Discover the source of the Scorn, the whispers, and cleanse the Keep of corruption.

Return to Orin to speak with her.
Lodi has another lead. Perhaps the time scar he's gotten wind of in the Caldera may reveal something more.
Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
Although hope is waning, Lodi still wants to be thorough. Investigate the last of the promising time scars he's found.
Lodi wants to know if any of the scars in time are traversable. He's seen things he can't explain, and he's hunting for answers.
Investigate the time scars on Kepler's surface. Lodi thinks—Lodi hopes—that he might be able to go home.
Lodi's journal was present, but not the man himself. The strange energy signature Ghost has locked onto might provide a clue to tracking him down.
Fallen Exiles overcome by a particular energy resonate on a psychic wavelength with the Archon. Push back to distract him.
We need to build another connection to the Archon, with Lodi as a willing subject, in order to learn to prevent him from being possessed by force.
Something is on the line between you and Lodi, flooding the channel with interference. There seems to be a specific location where you can find a stronger signal to punch through and contact Lodi.
Work with Lodi to learn more about him and the mysteries of what is possessing him.
Lodi is concerned about possession. The first and best lead would seem to be the Archon of the Exiles. Draw him out and see what you can learn.
Lodi believes the Archon is still attempting to possess him. In reaching back, he hopes to learn how to actively prevent the connection.
Locate and make use of another point of energy to reach out to the Archon.

"Anomaly-Blessed. I am Rojin, the Altar's technician, and the one honored to deliver what help we can. We offer, in awe, our findings to aid you. Should you see fit, your impressive drone will receive actionable data to locate strangelet capsules, and use the Altar's relativistic connection with them as a cipher to pass into the cordoned regions of Kepler. With our current integrations and research, you will gain access to the Central Academy and the Exile's Accord."
"Most gracious, Anomaly-blessed. Transfer commencing."

"We shall continue our research into the other stolen strangelets. With further integrations, the remaining capsules will increase synchronicity with the Altar and allow us to impose a shifted perspective that ignores the cordons by our observation of the strangelet beyond them. It is a delicate alignment, but our efforts can only improve through iteration."

"Anomaly-Blessed, we rejoice in your victory. As does the Altar. It finds synchronicity with a new object on Kepler, but not a strangelet. We have not seen this type of connection before, and believe it is for you."

"Anomaly-Blessed, your field work is efficient and thorough. We are fortunate to have found favor with you. With the return of another strangelet, we are able to cull bad data from our hypotheses. We've narrowed your next destination to the Outer Steppes. We are locking the Altar to that strangelet capsule now."
"Go in certainty."
"This is all that is needed to align with the final strangelet."

"The Gorge can be accessed. Be wary, Anomaly-Blessed. The automatons that attacked Kepler have made the Gorge their home. Orin, saint of the Anomaly, has already departed to face them. Together, you will prevail."
Rendezvous with Orin before you go back to the Altar to integrate the final strangelet capsule.
Despite the Aionians's resourcefulness and ingenuity, the Singularity's instability has overloaded the Altar's systems once more, leading to a total shutdown.
You'll need to repower and restart the integration systems.
Integrating the second strangelet capsule has further strengthened the Altar's relativistic connection to the remaining stolen strangelets.
Access the Altar of Relativity to acquire the Aionians's research and align with the next strangelet capsule's location.
As you access the interface, it melds with Rosetta, speaking words from an Aionian into your inner voice.
There is a brief pause as Ghost accepts the data transmission.

Research and strange equations found at the Altar of Relativity direct you towards strangelet capsules in the Central Academy and Exile's Accord. Lodi tells you that the equations are called an "Observer Cipher." He tells you to think of it like a key that shifts open a lock, relative to you observing it or not. Ghost seems to understand.
Although you have acquired access to the Altar from Dean Rebecca, she says that an unidentified signal has been disrupting their systems since just before your arrival.

The disruption is outside of the Aionian Safe Zone around the Altar, so she has been hesitant to send her people to locate its source, but has released field monitor balloons to remotely triangulate the signal.
Ghost might be able to boost the field monitor's signal to punch through the interference and find the source of the signal.
Lodi has recieved information from the Nine regarding an artifact from the Department of External Observations. He wants to speak with you about what he's learned.
The Aionians' field monitoring buoys provided the metry to pinpoint the source of the disruptive signal, and it's Orin, last known to be an Emissary of the Nine.
Her location is somewhere near The Gorge. Search the area and make contact.
You've secured a third strangelet capsule, this one again from the House of Exile.
Hopefully the Aionians have made progress in tracking down the fourth.

Lodi and the Aionians have troubling news that their reactor has suddenly begun showing signs of a meltdown. This needs to be resolved. Outside of unstable integration, the time spent integrating another strangelet capsule before resolving the looming meltdown would almost certainly spell doom for Kepler and everyone on it.
Now that the Altar of Relativity's functionality has been restored, you can now integrate your strangelet capsule. In theory.
Drifter has an invitation to Kepler, same as you. Only difference is that his is trailing behind his ship. He'd like to meet on Kepler to discuss how it might impact both of your fates.
As you approach the Altar you feel a strange kind of hum. It is not audible, but you can feel it both physically and paracausually within you.
There is also something else there, a new…feeling? It's not anything you've experienced before. It's some kind of resonance beyond the physical and paracausal.
You feel satiated, and yet there is a sense that there is much more to whet your appetite on this planetoid… and elsewhere.
It seems that you've taken your first step into a larger, stranger world.
With the Central Academy strangelet capsule integrated into the Altar, the Exile's Accord remains untested. The strangelet capsule there is your next goal.
Lodi wants you to meet the Dean of the Aionian settlement, Rebecca.
She should be able to provide more information about where you can find more strangelet capsules.
As you return to the Caldera, Ghost picks up a transmission from the Aionian Altar technician, Rojin, it melds with Rosetta, speaking words into your inner voice.
It seems the Altar, or the Nine, have more to show you.

With the strangelet liberated from the Archon's Prime Servitor and integrated into the Altar, you feel it's time to secure the Central Academy from the Vex and retrieve the strangelet capsule they stole from the Aionians.

The Central Acedemy strangelet capsule vibrates through your glove, and flesh, and bone, into something at your core. You feel drawn toward the Altar of Relativity, where the strangelet capsule can be integrated.
An additional integration will help the Aionians narrow down the location of remaining capsules.
You've narrowly averted a meltdown and preserved the Altar of Relativity. With any luck, the final strangelet capsule should still successfully integrate into the Altar.
Head to Caldera and attempt the capsule integration. Ghost is hopeful that we won't have to power cycle it again.
The Aionians's updated strangelet data indicates the final capsule is located somewhere in the Gorge.
As you access the interface, it melds with Rosetta, Rojin's words form in your mind.

Dean Rebecca indicates that there is an Acceleron near the entrance to the Central Academy. It is a particle that could assist in dispersing the temporal blockages found across Kepler. Unfortunately, a Vex Mind has stolen it.
You need to draw out the Barricade Mind and destroy it in order to obtain the Acceleron, and take one step closer to recovering a lost strangelet capsule for the Altar of Relativity.
The final strangelet capsule has been accounted for and returned to the Altar of Relativity, opening our path to the singularity.
Before we depart to face the Archon and the Vex, a call from beyond rings through at the Altar.

Integrating a third strangelet capsule has further strengthened the Altar's relativistic connection to the remaining stolen strangelets. Now only the final strangelet capsule remains to be retrieved before the way to the singularity can be opened.
Your fireteam has earned Lodi's trust over the course of collecting three strangelet capsules. He wants to share a message with you and Ikora. Find them at the Cenote.

With a strangelet capsule in hand, you notice how it appears to dance and shift into differing waves depending on what is contacting the capsule, like coiled static reaching to a point of least resistance.
An obstacle remains before you can integrate it into the Altar.

The Haul was given to Drifter by the Nine, and has been used many times to bridge a gap between us and them. It may be the catalyst for why you, the Drifter, and Ikora were all invited to this place. Maybe even why Orin and Lodi found themselves on Kepler, too.
It's time to see what Drifter knows about the Haul.

The Exile's Accord strangelet capsule is still in your grip. Shifting its place in space takes effect, as if it is affixed at whatever point it rests. As you walk you can feel it drag, even in the quantum space of your loadout pack. But still, you feel drawn toward the Altar of Relativity, where the strangelet capsule can be integrated.
This will help the Aionians narrow down the location of remaining capsules.
The House of Exile and the Choral Vex of the Nessian Schism stand between a weapon and the singularity.

With the Rosetta technology, it will be significantly easier to communicate with the Aionians in general, and Dean Rebecca in particular. She must know something about how to reach the disturbance at the heart of Kepler.
With Orin's signal no longer disrupting the Altar, you can access the Aionian network for clues about how to track down the stolen strangelet capsules.
The Barricade Mind is in ruins, and its Acceleron is yours for the taking.

As the air clears, Ghost directs your attention to a nearby terminal that appears to contain Aionian language ciphers. This may be just what you need to help bridge communications with the settlement here.

With the ability to breach the Time Latches around Kepler now at your fingertips, the remaining capsules are within your grasp. Recover them from Exile and Vex possession, and return them to their rightful place at the Altar of Relativity to open the way to the singularity.
The Altar of Relativity has malfunctioned and requires some arcane method of maintenance to get it working again. Between Lodi, Ghost, and your fireteam, you should be able to figure it out.
There is a brief pause as calculations are run and ciphers are drafted. The Altar hums along.
The Archon lays broken under its "Giver." A message has been delivered and heard. And the Conductor remains one step beyond reach. Your fireteam waits in the Caldera to help forge a path forward.

LANGUAGE HELD IN TIME. ARE YOU PAYING ATTENTION, WEAPON? AN AVATAR OF LIFE. A WEAPON OF DEATH. DO YOU SEE THESE WORDS THROUGH GLASS AND LIGHT?

Eight connections rest, held in your grip, your mind, your will. Perhaps the representation of the celestial bodies you found before was meant to be a metaphor—one your paracausality can turn into an open channel.
The Nine's presence permeates Kepler. With Lodi's willingness to act as a catalyst, you may be able to learn more about why the Nine are here.

Lodi wants to hear what the Nine have to say. He seems confident in his ability to go through them, but his eagerness could be dangerous. Take point on this.
Venture out and seek a place touched by the Nine.
There must be more vestiges of the Nine to find. Search Kepler to uncover more slivers of the message the Nine want to share.

Though the language is difficult to understand, Lodi has offered his assistance in translating and mediating.
With the requested quantity of samples gathered, it's time to bring them to the researcher who needs them.
Humanity has another outpost here. Despite their differences, they came from the same Earth, long ago. Learn from the Aionians, and find those common roots.
Ghost wants to talk to you about the Aionians.

Ikora advises that she's located an Aionian terminal disconnected from the network in territory currently held by the House of Exile. Retrieving the data does the Aionians a favor, and provides you more ways to learn about them and what they're doing here.
Ikora has thoughts about your interactions with the Aionians and everything that's happened so far. Return to her to touch base.
To learn more about the Aionians, it would be best to start directly with them. See what the locals have to say to you.

We can't call in the big guns for this one. Gotta keep it quiet. So how's about you, me, and Crow go track it down and take it out? Quietly, remember."

This time, the ripple of paracausal force is so strong that you can feel its pull like a gravity well.

The console has been hastily, but cleverly, rigged for communications. When you approach, it flickers to life.
Micah-10 tells you about her mission to find and save unpartnered Ghosts. They returned to help the Traveler as soon as they could, but the Witness's infection caused chaos. They need help.

The console's interface shows an area of the Pale Heart that Micah has marked. She says she's receiving telemetry from a Ghost in the area, but it must be damaged; the signal is unclear. You'll need to search to find it.
She also says that some of the Ghosts have helped scout safe zones within the Pale Heart. You should be able to use them as LZs to travel more efficiently.

Since arriving in the Pale Heart, we've learned so much, and discovered so many secrets. So, of course, Savathûn wants a piece.
Standing on the ledge of the old Tower, you bring Ghost out.

He hovers in front of you, light blinking. "Guardian, I've been doing a lot of thinking. I know I haven't been very enthusiastic about using Darkness in the past, but…at this point, we can't afford to ignore something that can help.
Ghost has a few thoughts about this new power, but it's not safe to have that discussion here. Find a safe place in the Lost City to confer with Ghost.
When you approach Cayde, he motions for you to lean in close. His voice is a too-loud whisper.
All right. Nothing suspicious about this at all.
Ghost has found some leads for us to chase.
One points towards the Light's effects on the physical universe.
The other points towards Darkness's influence on minds and emotions.
Ghost says your actions have caused paracausal ripples throughout the Pale Heart. He thinks these ripples may manifest in a wellspring of power in the cave in the Refraction.

Your experiences at the Tree in the Blooming have brought you closer to the Light.
Savathûn has finally revealed herself, but she's still got plenty of secrets to keep. We need to find out what she's playing at.
We've been contacted by Micah-10, a legendary Guardian and old friend of Cayde's.

lines.text: Anwar… would've wanted his shell bathed in the Light of the Traveler. We should honor those wishes.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: The European Dead Zone. Darkness casts a long shadow there. You should tread lightly.

lines.text: If Peach was investigating something in the Cosmodrome, we should be able to find her trail and track her down.
lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.text: "Cayde doesn't remember. And… that's okay. What matters is that I'm here. That he's here. That somehow, in the face of all this loss and hopelessness… we found each other. I can hug him, one last time… and remind him that he was missed."
"That he saved me."
"While we've been doing everything we can to heal the Traveler, the Witness's push to complete the final shape hasn't slowed."

"I'm sending you to find Hecate, a scholar in Hive lore who once studied under Toland, the Shattered and Eris Morn," Micah explains. "Hecate was investigating a rumor that members of House Dusk were trying to ally with Hive broods in the Cosmodrome. The House of Devils have been gone for a long time, though. There has to be something else going on."
"Good hunting, Guardian."
Dejana could use a little boost of extra Light to get her on her way. Thankfully, we have an abundant source on hand in the Arbor.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: "I'll let you know when I have more Ghost telemetry to follow up on, Guardian." Then, with a warmth in her voice she adds, "Great work out there."

"So I found telemetry for Bean." There's a hint of mirth in Micah's tone. "He's a handful, always rushing off into hostile territory. He and I tend to cross paths on remote scouting missions, so the fact that his beacon pinged from Nessus shouldn't surprise me."
"Go make sure he didn't get caught in a temporal loop or some other Vex nonsense," Micah says with a laugh. "I'll keep an eye on things here."
Hecate could use a little boost of extra Light to get her on her way. Thankfully, we have an abundant source on hand in the Arbor.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: The Exodus Black has become a site of interest for unpartnered Ghosts hoping to resurrect a Golden Age pioneer as their Guardian. But something tells me that's not why Bean is out there.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: I hate being in Savathûn's throne world. I can feel her eyes on us wherever we are. Even when she was dead, it felt like she was watching us. And now… I know she is.

lines.text: The lunar Pyramid. This… this was where we came face-to-face with the Witness for the first time. I hate it there.
lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.text: I… I don't like the idea of going back into that Pyramid, Guardian. But we don't have any other choice.

lines.text: Well, this brings back memories. The Cosmodrome always does. I guess it's appropriate, then, that we end where we began.
lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.text: "I know Anwar's death weighs heavily on Balthazar," Micah explains. "He will heal, in time, as the Traveler will. Perhaps in their shared healing, Balthazar will find new spiritual connections to the Traveler too."

"I can't help but be worried about what you found while searching for him. I thought the Psion defectors sided with the Witness…" She falls silent in thought. "But it's looking more and more like that may be a deception."
Peach could use a little boost of extra Light to get her on her way. Thankfully, we have an abundant source on hand in the Arbor.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: "Mars." Micah says it like a curse. "Of course Citrine would be on Mars."

"Peach was lucky to get out of that situation with only a few dents and dings." Micah's relief is tempered by uncertainty. "The world outside of the Pale Heart is transforming… We've got no room for error now. I'll get Peach set up in a cleansing team here in the Pale Heart."
"I'll contact you when I have telemetry on another Ghost. Stay safe, Guardian."
"I'm putting her with a patrol of Ghosts to help expunge the Witness's corruption and she's taken right to it. And with any luck, she'll put her analytical mind to expediting the process."
"Good work out there, Guardian. I'll let you know when I find another Ghost."
There's a tale of a Guardian and a Ghost that have walked together through insurmountable odds. Ghosts love that one. Maybe I'll tell it to you some time.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: I know Akasha. She's not looking for a Guardian, she's looking for the unknown. Whether it's the Aphelion, secrets of the Curse, or traces of Savathûn's influence. She's there looking for one thing: answers.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: Peach never knew when to quit. I hear Suraya Hawthorne often said the same thing about you, Guardian.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: You can't trust anything Savathûn says or does. That goes doubly so in a world built from the cursed weight of her soul.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: Link is a smart Ghost, something serious had to draw his attention back to the Moon at a time like this.
lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.text: Come on back to the Arbor, we… we can talk about what happened to Anwar.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: The Taken are a threat even to a Guardian. Dejana is in a lot of danger, trapped out in the old reservoir in the EDZ. Let's go help her!
lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.text: Been a while since we've been to the Insight Terminus. I checked in with Failsafe and she says she hasn't seen Bean, but she seemed distracted… like something else was going on.
lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.text: The time rifts on Mars are so unpredictable. Most of the time they're unstable, ghostly. Then sometimes they snap into focus and present a moment out of time as real as any other. It's a shame we can't actually affect the past through them.
lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.text: "The final shape has reached Earth." Micah is weary. "We're running out of time."
Link usually isn't this reckless. We have to find him before he gets in over his head.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: "So this is interesting…" Micah trails off for a moment as she reads your report. "Akasha returned some analytics from her scans of the Dreaming City's Ley Lines, and it's troubling. There's Hive activity surging through the Ascendant Plane. Xivu Arath's brood. And as far as I can tell, she's a no-show here."
"Get back out there. One apocalypse at a time."

"Welcome back, I've got another Ghost telemetry for you." Micah is eager to get to work. "This time, it's Akasha. She's an unpartnered Ghost that has been systematically scanning Awoken territory for years."
"I look forward to your return."
"The unpartnered Ghost Dejana was last seen in the EDZ investigating Taken activity. Hopefully we can find her quick."
"Come back in one piece, okay?"
Heilung could use a little boost of extra Light to get her on her way. Thankfully, we have an abundant source on hand in the Arbor.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: Balthazar could use a little boost of extra Light to get on his way. Thankfully, we have an abundant source on hand in the Arbor.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: Not a lot of Ghosts go to the Dreaming City in search of a Guardian on account of the cyclical curse. Glint is one of the few who were successful. That doesn't make odds good for Akasha.
lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.text: The lunar Pyramid is where the Witness reached out to us, to try and sell us the same lie the Hive bought. Be wary, Guardian. There's no telling what still dwells in that thing.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: "I have Ghost telemetry for you, but a word of warning on this one." Micah sighs. "Anwar is a Ghost who has been through a lot. He was once a close confidant of the Speaker. After the Speaker died, Anwar started to question his connection to the Light, and began to seek the truth about Darkness."

"Anwar believes the Darkness is an intrinsic, universal force that must be tended to like a garden, lest it grow unruly. Do not let Anwar's beliefs cast a shadow of doubt on his allegiances. He is an unwavering ally, but one who questions everything."
"His telemetry data leads me to believe he may be inside the Pyramid on Europa," Micah says with a wary tone. "I don't know what you'll find there. Be safe, Guardian."
"Guardian, I have telemetric data for the Ghost Balthazar." Micah is eager to get to work. "He's an old friend of Peach, the first Ghost you recruited."
"Please, bring him back, and make sure he's safe."
Citrine could use a little boost of extra Light to get her on her way. Thankfully, we have an abundant source on hand in the Arbor.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: Europa brings back a lot of memories, new and old. It's hard not to feel sentimental when I see the snow drifts and ice. For me, that moon has only ever meant one thing: change.
lines.speaker: Micah-10

lines.text: "The final shape spreading to the moon isn't a surprise. But that it's hitting the Hive as hard as anyone else?" Micah sighs. "I guess there really is nowhere safe. No promise or allegiance that can save you."
"But ah, one thing at a time, I guess. I'll let you know when I know more."
Come on back to the Arbor. I think we both need to talk about what happened back in the Cosmodrome.

lines.text: Mars has always been a battleground. First with the Cabal, then the Hive, and now… different Hive. Regardless, it's a terrible place and I don't recommend staying long.

"You found a full set," Shaw Han says, shaking his head in disbelief. "The Gjallarhorn reborn. I can't believe I'm going to be here for its second coming."
"But I'm getting way ahead of myself," he chuckles. "You're going to need a targeting system, armored housing, the whole deal—and I think I can help you out with one of those."

"I had the New Lights training with this launcher before it got dry-fired one too many times and fell to pieces. The armor's still good, though. It withstood hundreds of training rounds without so much as a crack."
"Now we need to find a gunsmith as good as Feizel Crux to piece this thing together."
"Head on up to the Tower. I'll be waiting for you… I want to be there the first time you shoot that thing!"
"You've been around the system a bit, yeah?" he asks. "Have you ever seen anything like this?"
"It almost looks like a piece of an engram, right?" Shaw says. "But dead, calcified, empty. Engrams don't act like this. Once their data is drained, they decompile. It's weird."

"A New Light brought me this. Said he found it in a little gap in the rocks not far from here… before the Red War, Guardians used to call it the 'Loot Cave.' Rumor was it was overflowing with engrams for some reason."
"Do you think you could head to the Loot Cave and check it out for me? Any old piece of tech might help the Vanguard, and these days, we need all the help we can get."
"I pieced this together a long time ago so I wouldn't forget some friends I had," he says, then looks down. "Didn't work. Maybe it's time to let go of the past, but still honor it."
"Greetings, Guardian," Xûr says slowly as you arrive in his impossible space. "I have knowledge of a matter that was once lost, but is now prepared to come home."
"I used to hear stories about the Gjallarhorn, you know. What it was capable of, that kind of thing. Never got to see one in action, though."
"If you have a shell, then the Gjallarhorn never left us. Maybe it's time to bring it back."
"See what you can shake out of the Fallen scavengers around here. If you can find more traces of the original Gjallarhorn…"
"…you're about to change things for all of us."
"I have one last thing for you," he says, patting his pockets. "Hold it out, would you?"
"I found this in the rubble of the old vaults after Ghaul's attack. I've been holding on to it ever since… for hope, I guess. To remind me of the strength of the Guardians. And now—"
"—now I don't think I need a reminder," he says, then raises a fist into the sky. "Because the Guardians have the Gjallarhorn again!"
"Now get out there and let the galaxy know the big guns are back!"

Shaw rummages through a nearby pile of gear and pulls a tarnished housing unit from near the bottom.

You have gathered everything you need to assemble the Gjallarhorn yourself. Report back to Shaw Han's camp and create your legend.

He pauses as a newly risen Guardian approaches. Shaw shows them how to manifest a grenade by concentrating Light in his palm. The Guardian nods and walks off, flicking their wrist.
Shaw notices he has a white-knuckle grip on the shell. He hands it back to you.
Shaw Han has asked you to search the old Loot Cave for any sign of ancient treasure.
Shaw Han looks at the Gjallarhorn with unrestrained awe. "The weapon of heroes," he whispers.
You hold the Gjallarhorn steady and Shaw pulls something from a pouch on his belt: a small golden feather.
He presses the gold feather into the winged wolf that adorns the Gjallarhorn. It fits into place with a satisfying click.

"But as his thoughts merged with mine, it was as though I lived through his centuries of struggle," he says. "And suddenly, all questions the Conductor put in my mind were answered."
"It does not matter if am the 'real' Saint, or the 'true' Saint," he exclaims. "Every me, is me!"
"But still she forced me to my knees," he snarls. "She is growing stronger."
"And when she finds it… I will be ready."
"Don't worry," she reassures you. "It's an honorary title. The frog will have no real authority."
"You're back, and with samples! I have performed a full system upgrade, and I am ready for action, Captain! Nothing can stop us now, not even a bug. Which I mention because there was one…"
"The Conductor's words still echo in my mind," Saint confides. "A copy of a copy of a copy… Osiris pushed through time to find his Saint-14… and now, I live a life that does not belong to me."
"The Conductor whispered I should be thrown away," he murmurs. His words are heavy with pain and desolation. "A solution as simple as correcting an error."
"And maybe…"

Your discovery of the Echo's form, that of the Navigator, Oryx, has sent shockwaves through Vanguard leadership.
Drifter is gone, somewhere among the stars, and Eris is dead.
The Deputy Commander is formulating a plan. Your strength is needed.
You receive each reward, regardless of your selection.
You have obtained the Tome of Want but as blight and corruption overflow from Saturn, the Dreadnaught still requires your attention.
The Taken King is a fearsome foe, especially when backed by the Dread, Xivu Arath, and Savathûn.
But this is not the Oryx you remember. This is a shade, an impression of him left on the Witness and born through the Echo's power.
You must sharpen your will and load your weapons. For now, all that can be done is to contain this threat. Take the shape of violence and bring that purpose to your foes.
You receive each of these rewards, regardless of your selection.
Deep within the rings of Saturn, the ancient hull of the Dreadnaught burns with Ascendant rituals, and its halls sound with the foreboding voice of an ancient foe.
Ripples of this wash onto the shores of the EDZ, beckoning Guardians to investigate the corruptive disturbance.

The knowledge that the Eversion Anchors are linked to the Dreadnaught's weapon, and not just loci for the Taken to pour from, means their threat cannot simply be contained like a blight. It must be destroyed.
You receive each of these rewards, regardless your selection.
You have begun to walk the Path of Resolve and put a stop to an Anchor incursion within the Dreaming City.
Whether the Anchor was meant to draw in the Taken already there, or flood the Reef with new horrors will—thanks to your efforts—never be known.
Eris Morn is dead, slain by a Dread Subjugator while investigating the revival of the Dreadnaught.
She has left something for you in her City apartment.
You brought vengeance to every Dread and Taken you encountered and were able to gather valuable tactical data for the Deputy Commander.
However, the source of the Taken scourge and what the Dread are planning to do with Oryx's ship remain a mystery.
To access the Hive biosystems aboard the Dreadnaught, we need high-ranking biological signatures from Hive that were part of Oryx's brood.
It's gruesome, but you've been tasked with retrieving the Hive limbs necessary to access the Dreadnaught and disable its weapon's connection to the Eversion Anchors. Drifter is finding the targets.
The Tome of Want is an Ascendant relic of immense power. It allows the shaping of desire into purpose.
With it and Sloane's guidance, you will hone your Taken power and press ever deeper into the Dreadnaught, toward the source of the blighting scourge.
Sloane has a plan to hit the Dreadnaught and nullify the risk from the Eversion Anchors; but first, she needs you to get access codes by completing the "Hive Hacking" quests.
The Dread and the Taken seem to have combined their forces, or one is overtaking the other.
At any rate, they are acting together and utilizing the Dreadnaught as their base of operations, under the leadership of the Subjugator that murdered Eris.
Upon touching the Eversion Anchor you discovered in Hangman's Pass you were ripped into Ascendant space—a compressed linkage between the Anchor and the Dreadnaught.
You leapt from Earth, across the stars and into the rings of Saturn to board the Dreadnaught in mere minutes!
This link must be investigated further, and its danger assessed.
Along the way, you felt an unsettling presence resonating through the Ascendant Plane.
While on the Path of Resolve, extract Essence of Desire from the the Nether and offer it at the Shaping Slab in Last City.
You were tasked with investigating a potential Anchor incursion that would link Savathûn's throne world to the Dreadnaught.

You have begun to walk the Path of Resolve with the Deputy Commander's guidance, and through your contact with the Anchor incursion, you learned valuable information about the linkage to the Dreadnaught's systems.
Wielding Taken power is a risk, but one you can withstand if it means holding back the surge of blight spilling from the Dreadnaught.
Though… you cannot deny that you feel stronger.
You've discovered a connection between the Eversion Anchors and the Dreadnaught's long deactivated weapon.
If the link exists, the weapon could be operable again. Maybe this is what the Dread are attempting to do.
Your resolve has been strengthened by subsuming and wielding Taken power.
Recover the Tome of Want from somewhere within the Nether and use it to obtain focused rewards from Heresy activity chests.
Investigate the chamber above the Altars of Summoning.

"Perhaps what we think of ourselves is simply within our minds, not in our makeup. Perhaps what built us is not what we thought it was. Always prescribing rationale to the chaos. Always finding light within the dark. Never considering the possibility of a parallel existence within the very building blocks of life. The cards are not what we thought they were. But still we must play the game."

"What first appeared as nonsense and trickery has begun to reveal itself. Certainly we are being manipulated through these interactions, though there is an honesty here… a spark of truth that speaks louder than I sought to allow. I will give it some credence—but please, do not let my curiosity infect your truths."

"Their transmissions have ceased. But I am confident it is not the end of their trechery. You have continued to stand by me through it all. A beacon of light shining through their forced darkness. For that, I have only this remaining message to give."

"Pay little attention to the false equivalencies within these messages. They seek to use familiarity to lead us into the darker recesses of our minds… Do not misunderstand—these are certainly fascinating places to explore. But we do so at the risk of giving ourselves to something without our best interests at heart."

"How long have we lived without questioning the nature of our crafted existence? Do not mistake my curiosity for a turnabout of loyalty—the Light has given us life, while these things have given us only deceit and dysfunction. But… perhaps we are not as in control as we'd like to be. After all, what is the point of life without liberty?"
"Sinister transmissions seep out from our Unknown Artifact. Their intentions are anything but pure. Place your eyes upon them only if you seek to find truths among the lies."

"Please do not think I have strayed from the Light. Understand that first and foremost, knowledge will save us all. Know thy enemy… a cliché, yes. But for a reason. Please realize this enemy—it is not like our other enemies. It fights with a different kind of force. Were we to simply shoot at it, I fear we would never stand a chance. Sometimes you must accept another's truth to understand their weakness. I hope you'll join me on this journey."
"Your efforts to understand the Pyramid were valiant. You have the Vanguard's admiration and thanks. We will fight this looming threat together, side by side."

"These words contain an ancient and unknown power. They are something beyond manipulative ruminations. There is a cry within them, one that seeks to be heard, lost in a sea that only dampens their truths. We must let them be heard. It may be our only way to prepare for whatever comes next."

"We know we should keep ourselves from these deceptive interactions, but what we are learning here are truths previously untold. They are asking to be understood. To be known. Perhaps their intentions are far less black-and-white than we first assumed. As always, stay cautious… but perhaps we should not stray from learning the secrets of the universe."
"Hope for humanity lies with our future, not our past. What you did within that Pyramid was no small feat. But the true onslaught is yet to come. When it does, we will be ready."

"You must see this… The implication is an alteration of the very fabric of reality as we know it. Who or what has life descended from? It cannot be what these transmissions suggest. But at the same time, perhaps maybe… I believe you must judge for yourself."

"Somewhere in the space between it all… between the truth and the lies, between power and weakness, between day and night, I have lived. In the gray. I believed not by choice, but by force. Chaos reigned, and I embraced it, but ultimately sought to regain equilibrium. Now, however, if these stories are true, I wonder… Perhaps there is only chaos. Perhaps it is the only thing worth embracing."
"On behalf of the Vanguard," she says, "and…from Eris, as well."

The strange Hive rituals within Sorrow's Harbor have proven to be only the tip of the iceberg. Eris believes the remaining Daughters of Crota are sacrificing Nightmares to obtain their dark energy. What the Daughters are using them for, she does not know. But all signs point beneath the Harbor itself.
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.
Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.
Ikora believes Eris is more than just an ally. She's a friend. One you've stood by through thick and thin.
Ikora thanks you. She feels nothing but admiration and appreciation for you and your efforts in helping Eris Morn on the Moon.
A mechanism of the occult built by Eris Morn to harness even the most unstable of magics. Access the lectern to create gear using Nightmare Essences and collect bounties.

Ikora wishes you a happy Festival of the Lost and apprises you of her progress on the Vex portal, where construction is proceeding as planned. But there's more work to be done before the portal can be put to use.
Enjoy the Festival of the Lost while Ikora continues work on the Vex portal.

Never a dull moment for the Vanguard. While Zavala orchestrates regular operations across the system and directs the fight to keep our hold on the Moon, he trusts you and Ikora to tackle the Vex crisis head-on.

The portal is completed. Now, at last, the final phase of Ikora's plan to eliminate the Undying Mind can be put into practice. She and Zavala have tested the hardware extensively, locating and destroying dozens of instantiations of the Undying Mind—but there are hundreds, if not thousands, of copies still lurking in the Garden. This task now falls to you.
Once a Lightbearer, Eris Morn descended into the Hellmouth of the Moon where she lost her fireteam, her Ghost, and her Light to the Hive.
Your success in entering the Pyramid and obtaining the Unknown Artifact has prepared us more than ever for the looming threat of the Darkness. But this is no time for rest.

Ikora has analyzed the data you collected, and it all points to a single conclusion: the Vex have resurrected the Undying Mind, a Hydra built to seize control of the Black Garden. It appears to be hiding itself in multiple co-occurrent timelines. Ikora intends to devise a plan to deal with this new threat but needs time to sort out the details.
Continue your efforts in the Vex Offensive activity while Ikora develops her plan.
The Festival of the Lost is nearing its end. Be sure to collect any remaining masks and participate in all associated activities this week!
Your Power level is too high to use this.
Zavala is thankful for your efforts inside the Pyramid. You've done well today.
Whispers continue to flow from the Unknown Artifact, but their transmissions have stopped.
Speak with Zavala about the emerging Vex crisis on the Moon.

The efforts of Guardians within the Black Garden seem to have unlocked the Unknown Artifact. It now provides communications from something… sinister. Eris warns us not to bow to it but believes the Artifact too valuable to dispose of.

Somehow, within the Pit of Heresy, the remaining Daughters of Crota managed to revive Zulmak, strengthened and protected by the Darkness within the crystal. With their rejection of sword logic, Crota's daughters have become far more dangerous. You may have scared them off for now, but there is no doubt they will seek revenge.

The Vex of the Black Garden, bidden by some unknown force, have turned their attention to the Moon, wrenching open gateways and pouring troops by the dozens onto the lunar surface. Their very presence is a threat to the Vanguard's tenuous grasp on the Moon. Something must be done.
Ikora asks you to deal with any Vex incursions currently in progress on the Moon. When the threat is contained, check in with Eris Morn.
First the Nightmares, and now the Vex… the Moon is growing more dangerous by the minute. Eris cannot break her vigil over the Pyramid, but this threat must be dealt with—and swiftly.
Ikora Rey has received disturbing news from the Moon and needs a Guardian she trusts to deal with it.
Check in with Eris Morn concerning the Vex incursions on the Moon.
Ikora thanks you for your efforts but implores you to remember that the fight for existence is still ahead of you.
Ikora is grateful for your efforts on the Moon. She has a gift for you to express that—something she thinks you might find useful.
Speak with Ikora about the latest developments in her plan to slay the Undying Mind.
Speak to Eris.
Speak to Ikora at the Tower about what you discovered within the Pyramid.
Search Sorrow's Harbor for the entrance to the Pit of Heresy.
Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.
Speak to Eris in Sanctuary.
Press Accept to receive Eris's message.
Enter the Black Garden to locate and defeat the Undying Mind.
Speak to Eva Levante in the Tower.
Speak to Eris regarding discoveries made within the Black Garden.
Speak to Ikora in the Tower about the latest developments in her plan to destroy the newly resurrected Undying Mind.
Collect any further communications it sends, but remain cautious. There is little here to trust.
Speak to Ikora about what you did to help Eris with the phantoms that haunted her.
Speak to Ikora at the Tower about the data you collected in the Black Garden.
Explore the Garden, find the intention driving these incursions, and work with Ikora to put an end to them.
Speak to Zavala about what you found within the Pyramid.

"So, Cayde left something with me," Ghost says thoughtfully. "It's a Hunter field journal. I'm not sure where it originated, but the oldest files on it contain fragmentary data from the Golden Age. There's a wealth of information here about the founding of the City, along with field reports on some of humanity's oldest enemies."
Decrypt your Pale Heart Engrams into weapons and armor.
Apply this catalyst to the Exotic Fusion Rifle Tessellation.
Your Ghost has been by your side all along. No matter what.
Complete Pathfinder objectives, Overthrow, Lost Sectors, and Cysts, and open chests in the Pale Heart to increase your Ghost reputation and earn rewards.
Use 1 Treasure Key to Open
Use 5 Treasure Keys to Open
Use 7 Treasure Keys to Open
Use 3 Treasure Keys to Open

Use before the next Call to Arms event. Expires when the next Call to Arms event starts.
An artifact bridging Aionian science and spiritual belief.
The Altar of Relativity hums as you approach, and an armament for the Weapon materializes.
Collect your reward for completing all missions on Legendary difficulty.
Eliksni from the House of Exile plan to destroy the structural history of the Aionians, and most of the campus with it. Stop them before it's too late!
Fight through subordinate Vex to lure out and defeat a Gate Lord in the Aionian Campus.
Draw out the Vex Barricade Mind and defeat it to claim the Acceleron that it holds.
Go to the Agricultural Center at the Aionian Campus to eliminate the Vex sabotaging the last stable food production on Kepler.
Rescue Aionian scientists, taken captive by Exiles, to obtain the Acceleron they have been studying.
Infiltrate the Black Garden to defeat the Conceptual Mind that holds the data you need.
Purpose and want orbit each other, influencing but seldom meeting. Reshape their paths into one and be made whole.
Complete sections of the Nether and defeat bosses, destroy Sigil Stones, and turn in Metastasized Essentia to increase mastery of your chosen path.
"Failsafe briefed me about your progress on Nessus," she says. "She seems pleased that things are going so well."
"Give Failsafe all the support she needs. She may be a bit unpredictable herself, but she's our best source of intel on the Vex."

"By analyzing viable radiolaria samples from different sites across the planet," she explains, "I can determine whether the aberrant behavior of the Vex is a regional phenomenon, or something deeper."
"C'mon, Captain," she says, clearly eager to show you around Nessus. "Let me take the lead for a change."
"It'll be an adventure."
"Captain, is Saint-unit… okay?" she asks. "It sounded like the Conductor told him some stuff that really got to him."
"We will locate it, and we will make it pay!"
"It is super weird!" she says. "I have been observing the Nessus Vex for centuries, and their current behavior is utterly unfamiliar to me."
"The Vex are a techno-organic mesh of networked consciousness," she begins to explain, "unbound by time, inevitable and patient and cruelly ambivalent, et cetera."
"And that terrifies me."
"Captain! This is the beginning of our research partnership. The Sampler I have sent you can extract unique radiolaria formations from new silica structures erupting on the surface of Nessus."
"This is better," she says. "I'm running those scans Ikora wanted, and I've got some ideas about new sample sites down on Nessus."
"I want you to know," she confides, "I'm glad to be a part of the team again. Working with you and the Vanguard, the whole deal."
"It's really… it's nice."
"Anyway, ready when you are," she says with forced enthusiasm, though her filter fails to re-engage. She sighs. "Let's just get going."
Give Failsafe your research specimen and receive a message at the holoprojector in the H.E.L.M.
Ikora greets you on the holoprojector while Failsafe processes the data you retrieved from the aberrant Vex.

She tells you her contacts have been studying the Valence, the strange aurora you've noticed spreading from the Traveler. The phenomenon began when the Witness was killed, and the mysterious object that fell to Nessus originated from that astral cloud.
She thinks the Nessus Vex have retrieved the object—and you must learn all you can, as quickly as possible.
Failsafe is delighted by your return. She excitedly shares how she believes she can be of use to you as you discover more about the Nessus Vex.
She admits would need a temporary promotion in order to plan the mission to find the radiolite and crystallized radiolaria samples herself… and takes your momentary silence as permission.
Failsafe requests you use the Standard Radiolite Sampler to extract samples from the Well of Flame on Nessus.
NES002-C is likely to look similar to the other specimen you have already collected.
There's concern in Failsafe's synthesized voice as she discusses Saint's ordeal on Nessus.
Failsafe will dedicate herself to studying the research samples so you can prepare to fight the Conductor.
Scans detect a radiolite vein that runs all the way to the Glade of Echoes. Following it might lead to a better scan location.
Failsafe, fully updated and integrated into Vanguard systems, requires your help to investigate the strange behavior of the Vex.
Failsafe delivered a Standard Radiolite Sampler and asked you to investigate strange silica formations within the Well of Flame on Nessus.
Speak with Failsafe about the research specimen at her remote uplink.
Failsafe has been analyzing the samples and data you collected from Nessus, and she sums them up in a single word: Weird.
Failsafe has sent you a Standard Radiolite Sampler. It displays a series of radiation detection bands. There is also a note.
Failsafe has designated a central point for a large number of nodes within the Well of Flame.
Speak with Saint-14 and learn what happened to him on Nessus.
Failsafe greets you and shares that Ikora requested that she redouble her efforts to study the aberrant Nessus Vex.
To maximize the power flowing to her research banks, she turns off her socialization filter. She sounds audibly relieved as her voice is stripped of its forced politeness.
Perhaps due to the disabled filters, she tells you that she appreciates being given the chance to help on this mission.
At the Exodus Black on Nessus, follow Failsafe's proximity sensor to locate the optimal scanner activation spot. Keep an eye on your helmet's readout for proximity readings.
Deliver Failsafe's research specimen within the "Exodus Crash" strike.
Follow Failsafe's improved readings to the Chamber of Water and search for radiolaria samples.
Secure high-priority data to discover the connection between the Vex and the mysterious object that fell to Nessus.
Go to the Hallows on Nessus to complete Failsafe's scan data.
Follow Failsafe's improved readings to The Cistern area of Nessus and search for radiolaria samples.
Investigate Saint-14's last known coordinates in mission "Mesmerize".
Follow Failsafe's improved readings to the Pools of Luminance area of Nessus and search for radiolaria samples.
"There are still threats on our horizon, Guardian," Ikora says. "But we will face them together. As a team."

"The Light alone does not make one a Guardian," Ikora says warmly as you approach. "Dedication, bravery, the will to protect those who can't protect themselves… they are what define us. And you are a shining example of them all. Thank you."
You were unable to access the memory linked to the worm statue. Ikora asks you to return to Mars to discuss what happened.

Ikora reckons with the revelation that she may be partly responsible for Savathûn's theft of the Light. But with the news that Savathûn also intends to pull the Traveler into her throne world and seal it away, there is no time to lose. She sends you to Fynch to follow up on another lead.
A trusted source has informed Eris of an artifact in Savathûn's throne world that might hold the answer to how she acquired the Light. Eris wants you to infiltrate Savathûn's fortress and find it.
Fynch believes there might be an important artifact hidden in Savathûn's temple to Oryx. He's offered to help you reach the temple and find out.
As you speak, the ritual is already beginning. Complete "The Ritual" mission in the Throne World.
Ikora wants you to follow up on a tip from Fynch. He believes there may be another important artifact hidden in a dangerous area of Savathûn's throne world.

Ikora believes that strengthening your connection to Darkness will improve your Deepsight ability, allowing you to "read" the memory associated with Sagira's shell. The Pyramid on Europa might grant you the power you seek.
When you found Sagira's shell, you heard an echo of Savathûn's voice, speaking about something called the "Witness." Ikora awaits you on Mars to discuss what you heard.
The Hidden have identified an area in Savathûn's throne world that might allow you to access the memory tied to Sagira's shell. Ikora has sent you to investigate.
With Savathûn dead, Ikora wants your help answering some lingering questions about the Witness. Queen Mara Sov has requested your presence, and Ikora believes she has vital information to share.

Ikora believes the worm statue you found before may not be a statue at all, but instead the calcified corpse of the worm itself. The memory locked within is ancient — too ancient to reveal by normal means. But Ikora has a plan, and it involves the Relic.
Ikora has a theory about how to stop Savathûn from stealing the Traveler, but she needs your help.
The last memory you saw revealed that Savathûn was chosen by the Traveler, the same as any Guardian. You should consult the Vanguard about this shocking revelation.
You acquired a piece of the crystal prison that held Savathûn before she acquired the Light. This fragment might hold a memory that explains what happened.
Savathûn is defeated, but her throne world is still swarming with enemies, and the Witness is still at large. Ikora wishes to speak with you about the work yet to be done.
When Ikora unlocked the memory tied to Savathûn's worm familiar, she discovered the proto-Hive were tricked by the Witness. This information might be the key to stopping Savathûn.

Ikora believes Savathûn can be stopped by showing her the memory of how she and her siblings were tricked by the Witness. Her ritual to steal the Traveler has already begun, so there's no time to lose.

Ikora explains that there's a final step to accessing the memory linked to Sagira's shell. You need to locate a concentration of psychic energy that will help manifest the memory. The Hidden have identified such a location in Savathûn's throne world.

With Fynch's help, you acquired a piece of Oryx's Tablets of Ruin. If you bring the Tablet to the Altar of Reflection, you may be able to witness another of Savathûn's memories. Return to the Altar in Witch's Echo.

Ikora believes that when you picked up Sagira's shell, you heard a fragment of a memory belonging to Savathûn. Your interaction with the Relic unlocked a new ability in you, one related to Darkness. She believes you can strengthen this ability at the Europan Pyramid, and in doing so, gain access to the full memory linked to Sagira's shell.

With Fynch's help, you recovered a strange artifact: a statue of the worm familiar that spoke to Savathûn before she and her siblings became the Hive. This no doubt holds an important memory from her early life.
After witnessing two of Savathûn's memories, one of which detailed her plan to steal the Traveler from our sky, it's time to return to Ikora with your findings.
As a reward for completing the Legendary Campaign, you have received powerful gear to help in the battles to come.
Fynch is excited to hear of our progress and lets us in on another lead.
Hidden in the Throne World is a monument to Savathûn's brother, Oryx. Fynch believes that location might hold more information about how Savathûn acquired the Light.
You visited the Pyramid on Europa to strengthen your connection to Darkness. Before you return to Savathûn's throne world, Ikora wants to speak with you about Sagira's shell.
The rebel Hive Ghost, Fynch, knows the location of a Hive temple that might hold useful information about Savathûn. Although he's wary of you, he's agreed to help you infiltrate it.
You have completed the Legendary campaign. Please select your reward.

You saw a memory where Savathûn, disguised as Osiris, may have tricked Ikora into revealing information about the Light. Before you speak to Ikora about it, however, Fynch has an important lead to share.
Complete "The Cunning" mission in the Throne World.
Meet Mara Sov, Queen of the Awoken, near the Relic.
Meet Ikora on Mars.
Complete "The Ghosts" mission.
Complete "The Cunning" mission.
Complete "The Mirror" mission.
Complete "The Lightblade" strike.
Complete "The Mirror" mission in the Throne World.
Complete "The Lightblade" strike in the Throne World.
Complete "The Ritual" mission.
Complete "The Last Chance" mission.
The Witness undoubtedly seeks a second Collapse. If we are not prepared for its arrival, we will fall again… this time, for good.

lines.text: A curse? Killing Sav's worm? Yeah, okay, I think I can maybe help with that! Take this casing—it's enchanted with all sorts of Hive magics. Could be your solution!
lines.speaker: Fynch

lines.text: Savathûn's dormant curse is now killing her worm! You'll need to act fast to keep it alive before you can start looking for Mara.
With Savathûn taken care of, Mara Sov has arrived to help us acquire knowledge in preparation for The Witness.
You have what you need to begin revitalizing Savathûn's worm. In the meantime, Mara has located another incubator in the Sepulcher Lost Sector.
Fynch has transmitted details of a Cryptoglyph rune location. Track it down to re-energize the Cryptoglyph once more.
The Sepulcher Lost Sector awaits you somewhere within the Florescent Canal.
Mara has asked that you take Savathûn's dying worm into the Throne World and find a way to revitalize it.
Fynch has pointed you in the general direction of another rune. Canvas the area and gather leads.
The casing provided by Fynch may save Savathûn's worm, but you'll need to find a way to combine the two. Seek energy to sustain the worm in the meantime.
The Metamorphosis Lost Sector awaits you somewhere within the Miasma.
You have what you need to continue revitalizing Savathûn's worm. Mara has located another incubator, this time in the Metamorphosis Lost Sector.
The rune was stolen and stashed away before you could get to it. Seek out the nearby Deepsight cache to retrieve it.
Mara believes that truths about The Witness and our Collapse lie within the mind of Savathûn's dying worm.
In order to learn what it knows, you and Mara must first revitalize it.
The rune has been drained of its power. Recharge it by defeating Scorn in the Throne World.
The Extraction Lost Sector awaits you somewhere within Quagmire.
Fynch has transmitted details of a Cryptoglyph rune location. Track it down to re-energize the Cryptoglyph.
Visit Mara Sov in the Enclave on Mars.
Visit Fynch.
Travel to the Temple of the Cunning to locate a Cryptoglyph Rune.

Understand most words and sentence structures in Aionian, allowing for a greater range of linguistic interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.

Decipher Aionian characters, allowing interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.

Investigate a Vex network node in the EDZ that has been overwritten with a single word: AVALON.

Wizards channel a restorative ritual over the Monstrosity.

Defeat the Taken Pyromaster.

Found during Week 5 of "The Bladed Path" quest.

"The Pyramid wastes no time—a phantom of Toland has arrived with every intention of distracting me. It will not work."
"The phantom of Eriana-3 now haunts me alongside the rest. They are a burden that weighs heavy on my mind."
"A phantom of my deceased fireteam member Sai Mota haunts me. It is only a trick of the Pyramid."
"It appears the screams of Sai's phantom have brought forth another burden for me to bear—the phantom of Vell Tarlowe."
"It is no surprise that the Pyramid now inflicts the phantom of Omar Agah upon me. The Pyramid will do anything to stop us from getting inside."

Your discoveries within the Pyramid are key to the future and survival of all—but the Nightmares continue their attack across the entire system, beyond our Moon. They must not be allowed to spread any further.
Stay vigilant. Keep Nightmares at bay on every planet.

During Eris's time in the Hellmouth, she discovered many Hive curios. All that remained was an ancient talisman pulsating with Hive magic. Now, the union between the talisman and the Essence of Despair has yielded a powerful tool in the fight against the Nightmares.
The Cryptoglyph must be used to empower the Lectern of Enchantment near Eris. In tandem with the cleansed Essence of Anguish, this will yield another piece of Dreambane armor.
Empower the Lectern of Enchantment with the Cryptoglyph before setting off to hunt the remaining Nightmares.
More Nightmare Essences are required to craft the remaining three pieces of Dreambane armor.
No need to waver, Guardian. The Vanguard stands behind you every step of the way.
The Light is our strength. The Darkness will never take that from us.
From the Nightmare of Crota, you received an unknown object that harbors a dark energy. You leave it with Eris Morn so she can unearth its secrets.
In the meantime, the Moon hosts further mysteries to uncover regarding entering the Pyramid. The Hive seem to be exhibiting strange behavior that may be related.

As the Nightmare of Omnigul swept through camp, Eris noticed a strange reaction from the Essence of Despair. Upon further investigation, it appears the Essence can be of use in fighting these Nightmares. But first, it must be cleansed of any dark energy.
You have acquired further Nightmare Essences but are out of Hive curios with which to create more Dreambane armor.

After discovering the Hive's ability to shield themselves from the Nightmares, Eris learned of a dark power possessed by the Hive inside the Scarlet Keep. This power may be our answer to how they've protected themselves—and our key to creating more Dreambane armor.
Hashladûn has been disposed of, and with her death comes a path to victory: the Hive Cryptoglyph.

You now stand at the precipice of the future. The Pyramid holds many secrets within. Lift the veil, and find a way inside. Look for something within—anything that might help humanity fight the oncoming storm.
The Lectern of Enchantment glows with the magic of the Hive thanks to its newly affixed power source, the Cryptoglyph.
The Lectern of Enchantment can now alter Cleansed Nightmare Essences to create more Dreambane armor.
Eris believes that whatever these things are, they want nothing more than to destroy everything we hold dear.
Eris takes the Unknown Artifact from you. She desires to study it in hopes of making sense of all that you saw within the Pyramid.
Take this piece of Dreambane armor and use it to hunt the Nightmare of Omnigul.
Equip Dreambane armor mods to enhance your power within this mission.
Complete the quest "Essence of Despair."
Take the Essence of Despair and purify it any way you can. Then, return to Eris Morn.
Investigate the dark power within the Scarlet Keep.
Travel to the Hellmouth and locate the Catacombs within. Hashladûn's Cryptoglyph lies inside for the taking.
Return to the Enduring Abyss with a full set of Dreambane armor equipped, and find a way inside the Pyramid.
Traverse a treacherous cave full of deadly moths.
Soar through the air without touching the ground.
Slay an unstoppable giant and end its brutal ritual.
Take up a Sword and carve your way through the Hive.
"These Fallen sure know how to keep us on our toes."
Your journey towards mastering Stasis continues. Attune your Splinter, now enhanced by the one you retrieved from Praksis, once more at the Ziggurat.
A black pyramidal object that fits in your hand and hums with a soothing energy.
Variks is alarmed to hear about Eramis's lieutenants using Stasis. The situation is more dire than he realized.

He wants to remain on Europa in order to help other Eliksni who wish to flee Eramis, and asks you to help set up a comms network using a nearby array. That way, he can communicate with his allies and prepare for evacuation.

According to Shaw Han, Eramis's sergeant Bakris is still in the Cosmodrome to ensure recruitment to the army of House Salvation. Shaw reports evidence of Stasis recently found in The Divide, not far from an old Devils hideout.
Variks is surprised and impressed that you managed to defeat Phylaks. He now believes you may be capable of wielding Stasis without being corrupted.

He tells you that your next target is Praksis, the Eliksni who created the technology that allows House Salvation to wield Darkness. Defeat him and Eramis's plans will come to a halt. Variks believes he's been experimenting on the Vex, and if you disrupt his experiments, you might get his attention.
The next lesson is that of control. In order to wield Stasis effectively, it must become an extension of your will.
Discipline your mind, and you'll make this dark power yours, instead of the other way around.

The next Crux is located in the heart of House Salvation's territory. The enemies you face there will attack with the rage of the affronted. Focus your abilities with firm resolve so that the battle plays out exactly as you see fit.
An enhanced Splinter of Darkness that allows you to pursue your journey beyond Light.
Zavala has requested your presence at the Tower to congratulate you on defeating Eramis and discuss your further usage of Stasis.
With your control of Stasis stronger than ever, you're finally ready to take on Eramis.
According to Zavala, Eramis has left Europa to reconnect with the House of Devils on Earth. He sends you to Shaw Han, a Guardian patrolling the Cosmodrome, for more details on this new intel.
A new Fallen leader resides on Europa, building an empire out of Darkness. This new Kell, Eramis, must be stopped before she gets any stronger.
The Splinter of Darkness pulses in attunement with the Ziggurat. The first lesson is that of acceptance. Be bold and open your mind and body to the possibilities of this new power.
Now that you've accepted this weighty responsibility, find your way to a Crux of Darkness. Commune with it. It will give you a taste of what lies ahead on this path.
The Stasis-sealed chest you unlocked contained an interesting piece of armor. Bring it to Variks so he can examine it for you.

Now that you understand how useful this power can be, you should keep an eye out for more Stasis Seals. By breaking them open, you can obtain valuable equipment and destabilize House Salvation even further.

It's time to demonstrate your newfound skills in a much more impactful way. The Exo Stranger mentioned the members of Eramis's dark council each hold their own Splinters of Darkness. Variks will know where to find them.
Shaw's suspicions are confirmed: the Devils have agreed to join Eramis's army on Europa. To make matters worse, they'll be bringing along a battalion of Walkers.

Fortunately, transporting this kind of weaponry is no simple task. At present, Eramis's sergeant Bakris convenes with the former Devils in their hideout in The Divide. There's still time to show them that even with Stasis, House Salvation is no match for the Guardians.
The time has come for the Exo Stranger to reveal to you her secret.

In another timeline, her original timeline, she failed to stop the Darkness from manipulating Guardians and bringing about a second Collapse. Since then, she has been carried through time, trying again and again to prevent that dark future.

Looking at you now, she finally sees a future in which she might succeed. She thanks you, then reminds you that the fight has only just begun. More Guardians must take this path towards Stasis. She'll be here to guide those that do.

Keep up the fight against House Salvation and all the other enemies of the Traveler. And don't forget: you have an ally in the Exo Stranger. Return here to learn more about her past and any other secrets that may help you on your journey.
You've nearly reached the end of your journey. Attune your Splinter at the Ziggurat for the final time.

Variks tells you about Eramis, a new Kell of the Fallen, or the Eliksni, as they call themselves. Through communing with Pyramids, she has managed to harness the power of Darkness and use it as a weapon.
Variks escaped with proof of that Dark power, asking for help. If Eramis succeeds in giving this power to all of her Eliksni followers, nothing, not even the Guardians, will be able to defeat her.
Variks asks you to find Eramis immediately. Perhaps she can still be stopped.
Pursue Eramis, Kell of Darkness. Complete "The New Kell" mission.
The Exo Stranger is thrilled. Your progress with Stasis marks a new milestone for her.

In order to understand why, you must know what happened in her original timeline, one in which the Darkness corrupted all but a few Guardians. When this ushered in a second Collapse, the Exo Stranger thought all hope was lost. But looking at you now, she finds hope once again. Hope in a future in which the Darkness within us all can be accepted, controlled, and embraced. A future in which balance and truth can prevail for the good of humanity.
To take one more step towards this future, the Stranger asks you to approach the Ziggurat once more and embrace the Darkness within.
Hunt down and defeat Praksis, The Technocrat to cripple Eramis's empire.
Shaw tells you that Eramis has been trying to recruit her old comrades from the former House of Devils for a while; for her to arrive in person now must mean she's growing desperate.

Word is, she brought along a trusted sergeant, Bakris, the Adamantine, and empowered her with Stasis as a demonstration of the forces at her disposal. Shaw suspects the sergeant has remained in the Cosmodrome in order to ensure the Devils follow through on their pledge to relocate to Europa.

By reactivating the Vex portal built by Clovis Bray, Eramis endangered all life on Europa, including her own soldiers' lives. Though you successfully thinned the Vex hordes, Eramis was still able to collect the radiolarian fluid she needed and escape.

What she plans to do with this resource is not yet clear. What is clear is that the Darkness has fueled her anger into a reckless rage. She must be stopped once and for all. The time has come to complete your journey with Stasis.
Stasis is now yours to wield whenever you desire.
The Exo Stranger has given you a Splinter of Darkness and pointed you towards the newly arrived Ziggurat. Go to it and begin your journey towards mastering Stasis.
Hunt down and defeat Phylaks, the Warrior to strike a major blow to Eramis's empire.

The Splinter of Darkness pulses in attunement with the Ziggurat. The second lesson is that of resistance. Be mindful. Guard your emotions against the temptations of the Darkness as well as your own fear in wielding it. This will help you resist any attack on or off the battlefield. Put that into practice when you find the next Crux.
Though her recruitment scheme has been thwarted, Eramis has another ace up her sleeve back on Europa.
Eramis plans on reactivating a long dormant Clovis Bray facility by powering up a Vex portal.
Stop her before she reactivates the portal and unleashes the Vex, endangering all life on Europa.

You've defeated Phylaks and disrupted House Salvation's attempt to claim Vex territory. In return, you gained Phylaks's Splinter of Darkness. Bring it to the Exo Stranger. It may be useful in your journey towards mastering Stasis.

The Exo Stranger has returned, just as the Darkness was inviting you in. Instead of warning you to turn back, she says it's time to accept what it offers. The Light is not enough to face Eramis and her dark council. If you want to defeat them, you must embrace the power of Darkness as they have.

She hands you a "Splinter of Darkness." This will allow you to wield Stasis. There are others like it, all in the hands of House Salvation. Yours is weak now, but it will strengthen as your proficiency grows.
Lastly, the Exo Stranger offers you her campsite. As you collect lessons and keepsakes, return here to reflect on your experiences.
But first, you must accept the path before you. Begin by attuning your Splinter in the monolithic Ziggurat on the icy flats ahead.
Hunt down and defeat Eramis, Kell of Darkness to put an end to her reign of terror.
With Eramis's undefeatable power of Stasis in the way, Variks asks for your help. Many fellow Eliksni desire to break out from the grips of House Salvation.

You retrieved a Splinter of Darkness after defeating another member of Eramis's dark council, Praksis. Bring it to the Exo Stranger to enhance your own Splinter and continue your journey in mastering Stasis.
Variks is safe from the attacking Fallen for now. It's time to get some answers.
An enhanced Splinter of Darkness that allows you to further pursue your journey beyond Light.
Now that you've resisted the temptations of the Darkness, it's time to test your sharpened Stasis skills on the next member of Eramis's dark council.

Variks looks somber. When he witnessed Eramis releasing the Vex, he realized that she has truly lost sight of what she was fighting for. Now she has endangered everything the Eliksni have built on Europa.

As the Vex make their way across Europa and towards Riis-Reborn, Variks is planning to help some of his allies evacuate the city. They are carrying an important asset that he claims will be invaluable to House Light on Earth. He asks for your help defending them, and then the way will be clear for you to confront Eramis.
As you were going towards the Pyramid, a strange monolith has appeared in Beyond, along with a few old friends.
The Exo Stranger enhanced your Splinter with the one you retrieved from Phylaks. Take it to the Ziggurat in order to continue down this path.
The power of Eramis and her followers is beyond your capabilities.
The Exo Stranger is thrilled. Not only did you accept the power of Stasis, you put it to use by taking down Phylaks and retrieving her Splinter of Darkness.

Continue working with Variks to track down the next member of Eramis's dark council. Once you get a hold of their Splinter, the Exo Stranger can use it to enhance your own, which will in turn strengthen your proficiency with Stasis.

But don't get carried away. You have a ways to go before you can face Eramis. Now that you've accepted Stasis, you must learn to resist the temptations of the Darkness and use it solely for the good of humanity.
With that, she hands you back your Splinter, now infused with Phylaks's, readying you for the next stage of Stasis.

Variks disapproves of your new Stasis abilities. He thinks you're being reckless. He warns you to remember what the Darkness has done and what it is doing to Eramis. He refuses to believe that this is the only way to stop her.

But he acknowledges that you are free to walk your own path, even if it's a dangerous one. He urges you not to lose sight of your goal. To get to Eramis, you must begin by defeating the leader of her army: Phylaks. Thanks to his secret communication network, Variks learned that Phylaks was ordered to take control of an area currently occupied by the Vex.
Gather information about the whereabouts of Phylaks, the Warrior by challenging her soldiers in Eventide Ruins.

Now that Eramis is defeated, the Vanguard hopes to reclaim Europa for humanity. Zavala asks your help in destabilizing what remains of House Salvation. He informs you that Variks will help guide you through your first mission: sabotaging a Fallen weapons factory on Europa.
You have discovered your Darkness within, and the threat posed by Eramis is no more. Her frozen visage will haunt the vista of Riis-Reborn for eternity.
The time has come for you to complete your journey and truly master the power of Stasis.
The Darkness beckons you to Europa. Will you answer its call?
An enhanced Splinter of Darkness that allows you to pursue and complete your journey beyond Light.

The Stranger seems pleased as you hand her the Splinter you retrieved from Praksis. You've made progress in dismantling Eramis's dark council and shown that, so far, you have a good handle on resisting the temptations of the Darkness.

But the journey's not over yet. In order to wield Stasis against the Kell of Darkness, you must achieve perfect control of the power flowing within you. The Exo Stranger has seen what happens to Guardians who lack this discipline, but refuses to explain herself just yet.
She hands you back your Splinter, now enhanced by Praksis's. You're ready for the next stage of Stasis.

You stand now at the end of this path, having learned acceptance, resistance, and control. You have wielded Stasis with skill and to good end. You have ended the dangerous reign of the Kell of Darkness.

Investigate Praksis, the Technocrat's plans in Asterion Abyss.
